api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The API key for your Plain machine user.

enforce_api_limits.title: Enforce API limits
enforce_api_limits.description: If true, Polytomic will restrict itself to the per-minute cap of Plain API calls in minute_api_calls.

minute_api_calls.title: Per-minute call limit
minute_api_calls.description: The maximum number of Plain API calls Polytomic may make per minute across all syncs using this connection. Connection setup and health checks are excluded.
